entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The papers were calling it the "Tri..."
entries.dialogueText: The papers were calling it the "Trial of the Century" -- and they were right. Colonel Tarquin Soll, the so-called father of Sordland, was finally being made to answer for his crimes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After months of investigations and..."
entries.dialogueText: After months of investigations and hearings, the Supreme Court was about to deliver its verdict. I fairly bounded up the steps of the courthouse, eager not to miss a word.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the hallway, I encountered Ovid..."
entries.dialogueText: In the hallway, I encountered Ovid Grecer, still dressed in a suit and tie. The two of us shook hands.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the hallway, I encountered Heron..."
entries.dialogueText: In the hallway, I encountered Heron Garaci, still dressed in a suit and tie. The two of us shook hands.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the hallway, I encountered Orso..."
entries.dialogueText: In the hallway, I encountered Orso Hawker, still dressed in a suit and tie. The two of us shook hands.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Hell of a first case as Chief Just..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hell of a first case as Chief Justice, isn't it?"
entries.menuText: "Hell of a first case as Chief Justice, isn't it?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We got him, right?""
entries.dialogueText: "We got him, right?"
entries.menuText: "We got him, right?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I trust you've made the right choi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust you've made the right choice?"
entries.menuText: "I trust you've made the right choice?"

entries.speaker: Ovid Grecer
entries.title: Ovid Grecer: ""To say the least.""
entries.dialogueText: "To say the least."

entries.speaker: Ovid Grecer
entries.title: Ovid Grecer: ""Mr. President, as Chief Justice I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, as Chief Justice I am committed to maintaining a neutral stance."

entries.speaker: Ovid Grecer
entries.title: Ovid Grecer: ""Mr. President, as Chief Justice I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, as Chief Justice I am sworn to secrecy regarding my verdict."

entries.speaker: Ovid Grecer
entries.title: Ovid Grecer: ""But I will say that justice shall..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I will say that justice shall be delivered. Possibly for the first time in decades."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Must be a shock seeing your man on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Must be a shock seeing your man on the witness stand."
entries.menuText: "Must be a shock seeing your man on the witness stand."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I trust your personal loyalties to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust your personal loyalties to Soll won't get in the way of delivering justice."
entries.menuText: "I trust your personal loyalties to Soll won't get in the way of delivering justice."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm looking forward to hearing you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm looking forward to hearing your verdict."
entries.menuText: "I'm looking forward to hearing your verdict."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I trust your personal loyalties to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust your personal loyalties to Soll won't get in the way of delivering justice."
entries.menuText: "I trust your personal loyalties to Soll won't get in the way of delivering justice."

entries.speaker: Ovid Grecer
entries.title: Ovid Grecer: ""But I believe the history books wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I believe the history books will say I made the right decision:"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm counting on you, Mr. Grecer.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm counting on you, Mr. Grecer."
entries.menuText: "I'm counting on you, Mr. Grecer."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""See you in the courtroom.""
entries.dialogueText: "See you in the courtroom."
entries.menuText: "See you in the courtroom."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm glad to hear that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad to hear that."
entries.menuText: "I'm glad to hear that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded at me and went to change..."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded at me and went to change into his robes.

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Rest assured I have made the right..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured I have made the right decision for Sordland."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Fortunately, he won't be there for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, he won't be there for much longer."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Careful, Orso -- your strings are..."
entries.dialogueText: "Careful, Orso -- your strings are showing."
entries.menuText: "Careful, Orso -- your strings are showing."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Must be a shock seeing your man on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Must be a shock seeing your man on the witness stand."
entries.menuText: "Must be a shock seeing your man on the witness stand."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Hell of a first case as Chief Just..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hell of a first case as Chief Justice, isn't it?"
entries.menuText: "Hell of a first case as Chief Justice, isn't it?"

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""I think you're mistaking me for so..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think you're mistaking me for someone else. Orso Hawker is gone."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""To say the least.""
entries.dialogueText: "To say the least."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Now is hardly the time for small t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now is hardly the time for small talk."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll see you in the courtroom.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll see you in the courtroom."
entries.menuText: "I'll see you in the courtroom."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""And I'm looking forward to your ac..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I'm looking forward to your accepting it without question."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm watching you, Mr. Hawker.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm watching you, Mr. Hawker."
entries.menuText: "I'm watching you, Mr. Hawker."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gave an imperious sniff and went..."
entries.dialogueText: He gave an imperious sniff and went to change into his robes.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So he is. It'd be a shame if anyth..."
entries.dialogueText: "So he is. It'd be a shame if anything happened to his replacement."
entries.menuText: "So he is. It'd be a shame if anything happened to his replacement."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll see you in the courtroom.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll see you in the courtroom."
entries.menuText: "I'll see you in the courtroom."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Oh, right. Remind me who got rid o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, right. Remind me who got rid of him?"
entries.menuText: "Oh, right. Remind me who got rid of him?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How could I forget?""
entries.dialogueText: "How could I forget?"
entries.menuText: "How could I forget?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm counting on you, Heron.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm counting on you, Heron."
entries.menuText: "I'm counting on you, Heron."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He abruptly turned his back on me a..."
entries.dialogueText: He abruptly turned his back on me and went to change into his robes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Besides Soll and the judges, only a..."
entries.dialogueText: Besides Soll and the judges, only a select few others were allowed in the courtroom. After a thorough screening, I walked in.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As soon as I entered, I saw my pred..."
entries.dialogueText: As soon as I entered, I saw my predecessor, Ewald Alphonso, sitting right in the middle of the gallery.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I took a seat in the row behind him..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a seat in the row behind him and tapped him on the shoulder.
entries.menuText: Go talk to him.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I took a seat two rows in front of..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a seat two rows in front of him and stared at the ceiling. Eventually, I felt a tap on my shoulder.
entries.menuText: Pretend you don't notice him.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Anton! It's been a while.""
entries.dialogueText: "Anton! It's been a while."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's President Rayne to you.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's President Rayne to you."
entries.menuText: "That's President Rayne to you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Alphonso. To what do we owe th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Alphonso. To what do we owe this pleasure?"
entries.menuText: "Mr. Alphonso. To what do we owe this pleasure?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked happier than he had back..."
entries.dialogueText: He looked happier than he had back at Petr's villa. Color had returned to his face.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It has indeed, Ewald.""
entries.dialogueText: "It has indeed, Ewald."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It's the trial of the century, isn..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's the trial of the century, isn't it? I couldn't just sit at home."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Tarquin Soll entered the courtroom,..."
entries.dialogueText: Tarquin Soll entered the courtroom, escorted by Karl Greiser and at least half a dozen other guards. His hands were cuffed, but he held his head defiantly high as they walked him to the defendant's seat.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""How the mighty have fallen. I can'..."
entries.dialogueText: "How the mighty have fallen. I can't say it entirely saddens me to see him like this."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Although it would've been nice to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Although it would've been nice to grab some of those Member of Honor privileges for myself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""'Alphonso' and 'Honor' don't belon..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Alphonso' and 'Honor' don't belong in the same sentence."
entries.menuText: "'Alphonso' and 'Honor' don't belong in the same sentence."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""No, you made sure of that when you..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, you made sure of that when you ran that smear campaign against me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No president, current or former, s..."
entries.dialogueText: "No president, current or former, should be above the law."
entries.menuText: "No president, current or former, should be above the law."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That was Soll's pet status. It sho..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was Soll's pet status. It should die with him."
entries.menuText: "That was Soll's pet status. It should die with him."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""No, you made sure of that when you..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, you made sure of that when you turned my party against me."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Time heals all wounds. I foresee a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Time heals all wounds. I foresee a day when the Sordish people will get nostalgic even for me."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Says the man who bribed and extort..."
entries.dialogueText: "Says the man who bribed and extorted his way into the presidency."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Says the man who prevaricated his..."
entries.dialogueText: "Says the man who prevaricated his way into the presidency."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It's come down to that, has it? I..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's come down to that, has it? I wonder who's next on the chopping block..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My response was cut off as the cour..."
entries.dialogueText: My response was cut off as the court justices filed in, led by Chief Justice Grecer in his full judge's regalia. Alphonso and I rose along with everyone else in the courtroom.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My response was cut off as the cour..."
entries.dialogueText: My response was cut off as the court justices filed in, led by Chief Justice Garaci in his full judge's regalia. Alphonso and I rose along with everyone else in the courtroom.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My response was cut off as the cour..."
entries.dialogueText: My response was cut off as the court justices filed in, led by Chief Justice Hawker in his full judge's regalia. Alphonso and I rose along with everyone else in the courtroom.

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Founder of the Sordish Republic, F..."
entries.dialogueText: "Founder of the Sordish Republic, Former President Tarquin Soll. Former colonel and commander of the 6th Army of the Sordish Armed Forces, and the founder of the United Sordland Party."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After motioning for us to sit, the..."
entries.dialogueText: After motioning for us to sit, the judge eyed Soll. A slight smile played across his lips.

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Founder of the Sordish Republic, F..."
entries.dialogueText: "Founder of the Sordish Republic, Former President Tarquin Soll. Former colonel and commander of the 6th Army of the Sordish Armed Forces, and the founder of the United Sordland Party."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""You stand accused of 'multiple all..."
entries.dialogueText: "You stand accused of 'multiple alleged crimes against the state and the Sordish people' committed during your term in office."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could hear the quotation marks in..."
entries.dialogueText: I could hear the quotation marks in his voice.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Heron Garaci was seated next to him..."
entries.dialogueText: Heron Garaci was seated next to him. He spoke in a bored-sounding monotone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After motioning for us to sit, he e..."
entries.dialogueText: After motioning for us to sit, he eyed Soll. A slight smile played across his lips.

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""You stand accused of 'multiple cri..."
entries.dialogueText: "You stand accused of 'multiple crimes against the state and the Sordish people' committed during your term in office."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could hear the quotation marks in..."
entries.dialogueText: I could hear the quotation marks in his voice.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gloria Tory was seated next to him...."
entries.dialogueText: Gloria Tory was seated next to him. She spoke in an uncharacteristic monotone.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""As President you allegedly abused..."
entries.dialogueText: "As President you allegedly abused your position for your own personal benefit while undermining the Constitution you yourself created."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After motioning for us to sit, he e..."
entries.dialogueText: After motioning for us to sit, he eyed Soll. A mirthless smile played across his lips.

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Former President Tarquin Soll. For..."
entries.dialogueText: "Former President Tarquin Soll. Former colonel and commander of the 6th Army of the Sordish Armed Forces, and the founder of the United Sordland Party."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""You stand accused of multiple crim..."
entries.dialogueText: "You stand accused of multiple crimes against the state and the Sordish people committed during your time in office."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After motioning for us to sit, the..."
entries.dialogueText: After motioning for us to sit, the judge eyed Soll. A mirthless smile played across his lips.

entries.speaker: Ovid Grecer
entries.title: Ovid Grecer: ""Former President Tarquin Soll. For..."
entries.dialogueText: "Former President Tarquin Soll. Former colonel and commander of the 6th Army of the Sordish Armed Forces, and the founder of the United Sordland Party."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Isabel Edmonds was seated next to h..."
entries.dialogueText: Isabel Edmonds was seated next to him. She began reading off the piece of paper she was holding.

entries.speaker: Ovid Grecer
entries.title: Ovid Grecer: ""You stand accused of multiple crim..."
entries.dialogueText: "You stand accused of multiple crimes against the state and the Sordish people committed during your time in office."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""As President you allegedly abused..."
entries.dialogueText: "As President you allegedly abused your position for your own personal benefit while undermining the Constitution you yourself created."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Heron Garaci was seated next to him..."
entries.dialogueText: Heron Garaci was seated next to him. He spoke in a monotone, avoiding Soll's gaze.

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""As President you allegedly abused..."
entries.dialogueText: "As President you allegedly abused your position for your own personal benefit while undermining the Constitution you yourself created."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""You are also being accused of inci..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are also being accused of inciting violence against the Bludish people during the construction of the Soll Dam at Erzaren."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""You are also being accused of inci..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are also being accused of inciting violence against the Bludish people during the construction of the Soll Dam at Erzaren."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""You are also being accused of inci..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are also being accused of inciting violence against the Bludish people during the construction of the Soll Dam at Erzaren."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""As President you allegedly abused..."
entries.dialogueText: "As President you allegedly abused your position for your own personal benefit while undermining the Constitution you yourself created."

entries.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
entries.title: Isabel Edmonds: ""You are also being accused of inci..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are also being accused of inciting violence against the Bludish people during the construction of the Soll Dam at Erzaren."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""You are also being accused of inci..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are also being accused of inciting violence against the Bludish people during the construction of the Soll Dam at Erzaren."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""As President you allegedly abused..."
entries.dialogueText: "As President you allegedly abused your position for your own personal benefit while undermining the Constitution you yourself created."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I leaned forward in my seat, waitin..."
entries.dialogueText: I leaned forward in my seat, waiting for the verdict.
entries.menuText: Wait for the court's verdict.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I stood up and waved my hand."
entries.dialogueText: I stood up and waved my hand.
entries.menuText: Introduce new false evidence against Soll.

entries.speaker: Ovid Grecer
entries.title: Ovid Grecer: ""You have an objection, Mr. Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have an objection, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""You have an objection, Mr. Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have an objection, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""You have an objection, Mr. Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have an objection, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No, never mind. Carry on.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, never mind. Carry on."
entries.menuText: "No, never mind. Carry on."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. You're forgetting about the m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. You're forgetting about the millions that Colonel Soll embezzled from the state and squirreled away in foreign bank accounts."
entries.menuText: "Yes. You're forgetting about the millions that Colonel Soll embezzled from the state and squirreled away in foreign bank accounts."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The courtroom came alive with chatt..."
entries.dialogueText: The courtroom came alive with chatter. Alphonso stared at me, his mouth wide open.

entries.speaker: Ovid Grecer
entries.title: Ovid Grecer: ""I'm afraid the court wasn't provid..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid the court wasn't provided with a proper evidence on this topic, President Rayne."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""We, the Supreme Court, have thorou..."
entries.dialogueText: "We, the Supreme Court, have thoroughly examined the facts and are prepared to deliver our final judgement."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""I... of course. That's the third a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I... of course. That's the third and final charge against Colonel Soll."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""The court will not tolerate such b..."
entries.dialogueText: "The court will not tolerate such baseless accusations, President Rayne."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""The court will not tolerate such b..."
entries.dialogueText: "The court will not tolerate such baseless accusations, President Rayne."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Soll twisted around in his seat to..."
entries.dialogueText: Soll twisted around in his seat to glare at me. I felt my cheeks burning.

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""That is a new low, boy. Even comin..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is a new low, boy. Even coming from you."

entries.speaker: Ovid Grecer
entries.title: Ovid Grecer: ""We, the Supreme Court, have thorou..."
entries.dialogueText: "We, the Supreme Court, have thoroughly examined the facts and are prepared to deliver our final judgement."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""We, the Supreme Court, have thorou..."
entries.dialogueText: "We, the Supreme Court, have thoroughly examined the facts and are prepared to deliver our final judgement."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""We find the defendant, Tarquin Sol..."
entries.dialogueText: "We find the defendant, Tarquin Soll..."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""We find the defendant, Tarquin Sol..."
entries.dialogueText: "We find the defendant, Tarquin Soll..."

entries.speaker: Ovid Grecer
entries.title: Ovid Grecer: ""We find the defendant, Tarquin Sol..."
entries.dialogueText: "We find the defendant, Tarquin Soll..."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""Stop this trial at once!""
entries.dialogueText: "Stop this trial at once!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Valken Kruger's deep, authoritative..."
entries.dialogueText: Valken Kruger's deep, authoritative voice rang out from the back of the courtroom. Everyone turned to face him, looking confused.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Soll, looking as serene as I'd ever..."
entries.dialogueText: Soll, looking as serene as I'd ever seen him, barely blinked. Behind him, Karl Greiser reached for his firearm.

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""Mr. President, Your Honors -- I ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, Your Honors -- I cannot in good conscience allow you to continue besmirching the name of Colonel Soll."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gave a brief nod. Several dozen..."
entries.dialogueText: He gave a brief nod. Several dozen men in full military gear strode past him into the courtroom, armed to the teeth.

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: ""General Kruger, with all due respe..."
entries.dialogueText: "General Kruger, with all due respect... you can't stop the trial. You don't have the power."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""Don't make me upset, *Mister* Grei..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't make me upset, *Mister* Greiser."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""President Rayne has given the mili..."
entries.dialogueText: "President Rayne has given the military authority to intervene in case of a national emergency. I'd say the father of our Republic being treated as a common criminal constitutes exactly such an emergency."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That isn't what I meant.""
entries.dialogueText: "That isn't what I meant."
entries.menuText: "That isn't what I meant."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""General Kruger, I order you and yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "General Kruger, I order you and your men to leave the courtroom. Now."
entries.menuText: "General Kruger, I order you and your men to leave the courtroom. Now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Soll *is* a criminal. He's not you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Soll *is* a criminal. He's not your goddamn daddy."
entries.menuText: "Soll *is* a criminal. He's not your goddamn daddy."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""My apologies, Mr. President. Free..."
entries.dialogueText: "My apologies, Mr. President. Free Colonel Soll now, and I promise nobody will get hurt."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I glanced at Ovid. He looked back a..."
entries.dialogueText: I glanced at Ovid. He looked back at me helplessly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I glanced at Heron. He looked back..."
entries.dialogueText: I glanced at Heron. He looked back at me helplessly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I glanced at Heron. He looked like..."
entries.dialogueText: I glanced at Heron. He looked like he was trying very hard not to laugh.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I glanced at Orso. He smirked back..."
entries.dialogueText: I glanced at Orso. He smirked back at me triumphantly.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""All right. Uncuff him.""
entries.dialogueText: "All right. Uncuff him."
entries.menuText: "All right. Uncuff him."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You win again, Colonel.""
entries.dialogueText: "You win again, Colonel."
entries.menuText: "You win again, Colonel."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You... did you plan this?""
entries.dialogueText: "You... did you plan this?"
entries.menuText: "You... did you plan this?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Heron merely shrugged."
entries.dialogueText: Heron merely shrugged.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Orso merely shrugged."
entries.dialogueText: Orso merely shrugged.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without taking his eyes off Valken..."
entries.dialogueText: Without taking his eyes off Valken Kruger, Karl reluctantly unlocked Soll's handcuffs. As soon as his hands were free, Soll beckoned for me to approach the bench.

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Did you really think you could get..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did you really think you could get rid of me that easily?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A boy can dream.""
entries.dialogueText: "A boy can dream."
entries.menuText: "A boy can dream."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The military won't always be your..."
entries.dialogueText: "The military won't always be your lapdog, you know."
entries.menuText: "The military won't always be your lapdog, you know."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You'll pay for everything you've d..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll pay for everything you've done, Soll."
entries.menuText: "You'll pay for everything you've done, Soll."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Everything **I've** done? Oh, Anto..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everything **I've** done? Oh, Anton."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Authorizing armed attacks on innoc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Authorizing armed attacks on innocents to protect your own interests? Don't pretend you're somehow better than I am."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Stoking the Bludish conflict? Auth..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stoking the Bludish conflict? Authorizing armed attacks on innocents to protect your own interests? Don't pretend you're somehow better than I am."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Considering your own abominable tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Considering your own abominable treatment of our citizens, you're no better than I am."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""The only difference between you an..."
entries.dialogueText: "The only difference between you and me is that I will be remembered as a hero, and you -- well, you'll be lucky to be remembered at all."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He straightened his tie and smoothl..."
entries.dialogueText: He straightened his tie and smoothly motioned for the guards to escort him out of the courthouse.

entries.speaker: Ovid Grecer
entries.title: Ovid Grecer: ""Guilty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Guilty."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Guilty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Guilty."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Not guilty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not guilty."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Not guilty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not guilty."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You did it. You actually did it.""
entries.dialogueText: "You did it. You actually did it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The courtroom collectively gasped...."
entries.dialogueText: The courtroom collectively gasped. Next to me, Alphonso mock-applauded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Orso smirked triumphantly. Alphonso..."
entries.dialogueText: Orso smirked triumphantly. Alphonso crumpled his hat in his hands.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Heron smirked triumphantly. Alphons..."
entries.dialogueText: Heron smirked triumphantly. Alphonso crumpled his hat in his hands.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You never did stand much of a chan..."
entries.dialogueText: "You never did stand much of a chance. But bravo for trying."

entries.speaker: Ovid Grecer
entries.title: Ovid Grecer: ""Tarquin Soll, for the magnitude of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tarquin Soll, for the magnitude of your crimes against the state and humanity, I hereby sentence you to death by execution."

entries.speaker: Ovid Grecer
entries.title: Ovid Grecer: ""Tarquin Soll, for the magnitude of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tarquin Soll, for the magnitude of your crimes against the state and humanity, I hereby sentence you to life in prison."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Tarquin Soll, for the magnitude of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tarquin Soll, for the magnitude of your crimes against the state and humanity, I hereby sentence you to death by execution."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Tarquin Soll, for the magnitude of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tarquin Soll, for the magnitude of your crimes against the state and humanity, I hereby sentence you to life in prison."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The courtroom collectively gasped...."
entries.dialogueText: The courtroom collectively gasped. Soll fixed Heron with a disbelieving stare. Next to me, Alphonso broke out in mock-applause.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You did it. You actually did it.""
entries.dialogueText: "You did it. You actually did it."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You never did stand much of a chan..."
entries.dialogueText: "You never did stand much of a chance. But bravo for trying."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Colonel Soll, I hope you will forg..."
entries.dialogueText: "Colonel Soll, I hope you will forgive us for forcing you to endure this charade. I hereby declare this case closed and the court adjourned."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Colonel Soll, I hope you will forg..."
entries.dialogueText: "Colonel Soll, I hope you will forgive us for forcing you to endure this charade. I hereby declare this case closed and the court adjourned."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Someone in the room shrieked. For h..."
entries.dialogueText: Someone in the room shrieked. For his part, Soll barely blinked. He looked as serene as I'd ever seen him.

entries.title: Narrator: "Someone in the room shrieked. For h..."
entries.dialogueText: Someone in the room shrieked. For his part, Soll barely blinked. He looked as serene as I'd ever seen him.

entries.dialogueText: Soll barely blinked. He looked as serene as I'd ever seen him.

entries.speaker: Ovid Grecer
entries.title: Ovid Grecer: ""Court is now adjourned. Guards, yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Court is now adjourned. Guards, you may escort Colonel Soll to his cell."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Court is now adjourned. Guards, yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Court is now adjourned. Guards, you may escort Colonel Soll to his cell."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a grim smile on his face, Karl..."
entries.dialogueText: With a grim smile on his face, Karl roughly pulled Soll onto his feet.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As he stood, Soll looked straight a..."
entries.dialogueText: As he stood, Soll looked straight at me and twitched the fingers of one of his cuffed hands, beckoning me to approach the bench.

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Well, are you happy? You've robbed..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, are you happy? You've robbed an old man of his last few years of peace."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You don't deserve peace after ever..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't deserve peace after everything you've done."
entries.menuText: "You don't deserve peace after everything you've done."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You can find peace in your cell.""
entries.dialogueText: "You can find peace in your cell."
entries.menuText: "You can find peace in your cell."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm happy justice has been served.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm happy justice has been served."
entries.menuText: "I'm happy justice has been served."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You've still got eternal peace to..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've still got eternal peace to look forward to. Maybe."
entries.menuText: "You've still got eternal peace to look forward to. Maybe."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Soll bowed his head in mock humilit..."
entries.dialogueText: Soll bowed his head in mock humility.

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""We all must make sacrifices in ord..."
entries.dialogueText: "We all must make sacrifices in order for democracy to function. Mr. Greiser, if you will, these cuffs are beginning to chafe."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a reluctant sigh, Karl unlocke..."
entries.dialogueText: With a reluctant sigh, Karl unlocked the handcuffs. As soon as he was free, Soll beckoned me to approach the bench.

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""No. Just long enough to let me liv..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. Just long enough to let me live out my last few years in peace."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The courts won't always be your la..."
entries.dialogueText: "The courts won't always be your lapdog, you know."
entries.menuText: "The courts won't always be your lapdog, you know."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You don't deserve peace after ever..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't deserve peace after everything you've done."
entries.menuText: "You don't deserve peace after everything you've done."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Show some respect. Without me, Sor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Show some respect. Without me, Sordland would be a backwater. And you'd be nobody."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""If there was any such thing as jus..."
entries.dialogueText: "If there was any such thing as justice, you'd be headed straight to the chair with me."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""If there was any such thing as jus..."
entries.dialogueText: "If there was any such thing as justice, you'd be headed straight to prison with me."

entries.dialogueText: "That may be true. But it still doesn't make up for everything you've done."
entries.menuText: "That may be true. But it still doesn't make up for everything you've done."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""You see it as justice. The rest of..."
entries.dialogueText: "You see it as justice. The rest of Sordland may see it differently."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""You see me as a villain. The rest..."
entries.dialogueText: "You see me as a villain. The rest of Sordland may see it differently."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""For all your efforts, you've only..."
entries.dialogueText: "For all your efforts, you've only succeeded in turning me into a martyr."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""For all your efforts, you've only..."
entries.dialogueText: "For all your efforts, you've only succeeded in making yourself look weak."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""The end result is the same. I will..."
entries.dialogueText: "The end result is the same. I will be remembered as a hero, and you -- well, you'll be lucky to be remembered at all."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After one last look at me, he turne..."
entries.dialogueText: After one last look at me, he turned his back and allowed the guards to escort him out of the courthouse.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My legs suddenly felt as if they we..."
entries.dialogueText: My legs suddenly felt as if they were about to give way. I collapsed in the nearest chair.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stayed there as Alphonso left, th..."
entries.dialogueText: I stayed there as Alphonso left, then the rest of the spectators, then the justices.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He straightened his tie and smoothl..."
entries.dialogueText: He straightened his tie and smoothly motioned for Kruger's men to escort him out of the courthouse.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Isabel Edmonds was seated next to h..."
entries.dialogueText: Isabel Edmonds was seated next to him. She began reading off the piece of paper she was holding.

entries.speaker: Ovid Grecer
entries.title: Ovid Grecer: ""As President you allegedly abused..."
entries.dialogueText: "As President you allegedly abused your position for your own personal benefit while undermining the Constitution you yourself created."

entries.speaker: Ovid Grecer
entries.title: Ovid Grecer: ""You are also being accused of inci..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are also being accused of inciting violence against the Bludish people during the construction of the Soll Dam at Erzaren."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Soll, looking as serene as I'd ever..."
entries.dialogueText: Soll, looking as serene as I'd ever seen him, barely blinked.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without taking their eyes off Valke..."
entries.dialogueText: Without taking their eyes off Valken Kruger, the guards reluctantly unlocked Soll's handcuffs. As soon as his hands were free, Soll beckoned for me to approach the bench.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Tarquin Soll entered the courtroom,..."
entries.dialogueText: Tarquin Soll entered the courtroom, escorted by at least half a dozen guards. His hands were cuffed, but he held his head defiantly high as they walked him to the defendant's seat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a grim smile on his face, a gu..."
entries.dialogueText: With a grim smile on his face, a guard roughly pulled Soll onto his feet.

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""We all must make sacrifices in ord..."
entries.dialogueText: "We all must make sacrifices in order for democracy to function."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned to the guards."
entries.dialogueText: He turned to the guards.

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""If you will, these cuffs are begin..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you will, these cuffs are beginning to chafe."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a reluctant sigh, the guards u..."
entries.dialogueText: With a reluctant sigh, the guards unlocked the handcuffs. As soon as he was free, Soll beckoned me to approach the bench.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A villain like you doesn't deserve..."
entries.dialogueText: "A villain like you doesn't deserve peace."
entries.menuText: "A villain like you doesn't deserve peace."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Ideally, yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ideally, yes."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I'm surprised you weren't tempted..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm surprised you weren't tempted to grant yourself immunity along with him, though."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""After all we've been through toget..."
entries.dialogueText: "After all we've been through together? Well, I guess the trial of the century is quite a formal occasion."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked more haggard than he had..."
entries.dialogueText: He looked more haggard than he had at Petr's villa. When he removed his hat, I saw a bald spot on the back of his head.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Mr. Rayne. It's been a while.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Rayne. It's been a while."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""By the way, I'm sorry I couldn't a..."
entries.dialogueText: "By the way, I'm sorry I couldn't attend Mr. Vectern's funeral. I always liked the man."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you for your condolences.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your condolences."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No apology necessary. I'm sure Gas..."
entries.dialogueText: "No apology necessary. I'm sure Gasom has kept you busy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Everyone did. But he had his dark..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everyone did. But he had his dark side."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""By the way, I was sorry to hear ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "By the way, I was sorry to hear about Mrs. Rayne. Welcome to the club of divorced Sordish presidents."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No need to be sorry. I'm a free ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need to be sorry. I'm a free man now."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I couldn't stay home and miss the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't stay home and miss the trial of the century. I still can't believe you got the old man indicted."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It has indeed, Mr. Alphonso.""
entries.dialogueText: "It has indeed, Mr. Alphonso."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""The trial of the century, they're..."
entries.dialogueText: "The trial of the century, they're calling it. I must say I have mixed feelings about this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's no wonder neither of us could..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's no wonder neither of us could hold on to a wife. Sordland is a demanding mistress."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm not quite ready to talk about..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not quite ready to talk about it yet."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""At least yours left you after you'..."
entries.dialogueText: "At least yours left you after you'd already lost the presidency. I'm worried about my public opinion."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Evidently so.""
entries.dialogueText: "Evidently so."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His eyes darkened."
entries.dialogueText: His eyes darkened.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""That's a conversation for another..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a conversation for another day, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Actually, I'm a retiree now. I can..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, I'm a retiree now. I can rest easy, knowing my legacy is safe."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Of course. It must be a difficult..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. It must be a difficult time for you."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""So I won't bring up the whole Gaso..."
entries.dialogueText: "So I won't bring up the whole Gasom quagmire. That's a conversation for another day."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Albeit in foreign hands. But that'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Albeit in foreign hands. But that's a conversation for another day."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He frowned."
entries.dialogueText: He frowned.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You really do have a heart of ston..."
entries.dialogueText: "You really do have a heart of stone, don't you, Rayne?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""That's... pragmatic of you.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's... pragmatic of you."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I understand. I was a mess after m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. I was a mess after my wife left. Thank God it didn't happen while I was still in office."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I take it you're finally beginning..."
entries.dialogueText: "I take it you're finally beginning to understand all the challenges I was up against."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Ha. No president of Sordland is ev..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ha. No president of Sordland is ever free. Once this country has you in its grip, there's no wriggling out."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I know it's a difficult time for y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know it's a difficult time for you, so I'll refrain from bringing up the whole Gasom quagmire. That's a conversation for another day."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""But how have you been? Still tryin..."
entries.dialogueText: "But how have you been? Still trying to lead Sordland out of the mess I made?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""As is the one about your full-on e..."
entries.dialogueText: "As is the one about your full-on embrace of Malenyevism. My God, if there's anything Soll and I would agree on..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you mean Gasom? Because yes, th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you mean Gasom? Because yes, that is a mess."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""What happened to Gasom was nowhere..."
entries.dialogueText: "What happened to Gasom was nowhere near my fault. But that's a conversation for another day."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""But speak of the devil.""
entries.dialogueText: "But speak of the devil."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""How have you been otherwise? Still..."
entries.dialogueText: "How have you been otherwise? Still trying to lead Sordland out of the mess I made?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I think it's safe to say that it's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think it's safe to say that it's *my* mess now."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You see, {BaseGameText.AlphonsoToP..."
entries.dialogueText: "You see, {BaseGameText.AlphonsoToPlayer}. Being in charge of a country like Sordland isn't as easy as you think."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Not just trying. Succeeding.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not just trying. Succeeding."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Don't boast too prematurely. Sordl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't boast too prematurely. Sordland isn't out of the weeds yet."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""There's one particular thorn that..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's one particular thorn that still needs pruning..."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""And he who is considered a great l..."
entries.dialogueText: "And he who is considered a great leader today could end up in shackles tomorrow..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your mess isn't what keeps me up a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your mess isn't what keeps me up at night. It's Soll's."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You always did have it in for him...."
entries.dialogueText: "You always did have it in for him. Starting with when you helped oust him from USP leadership."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Or maybe you just wanted to get ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or maybe you just wanted to get rid of anyone who stood between you and the Maroon Palace..."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I remember a time when you were ea..."
entries.dialogueText: "I remember a time when you were eager to support the Colonel. Even at the expense of a new chance at growth for Sordland."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""But we all fell victim to his cult..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we all fell victim to his cult of personality at one point or another."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Speak of the devil.""
entries.dialogueText: "Speak of the devil."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""As is the one about how the Sordis..."
entries.dialogueText: "As is the one about how the Sordish economy is in even worse shape than during my presidency. If there's anything Soll and I would agree on..."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""As is the one about the rather dic..."
entries.dialogueText: "As is the one about the rather dictatorial path you've led the country down. My God, if there's anything Soll and I would agree on..."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Today is all about that man right..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today is all about that man right over there."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""What? That's not even...""
entries.dialogueText: "What? That's not even..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. You're forgetting about the d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. You're forgetting about the deep state he established to undermine the democratic institutions of this republic."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The courtroom came alive with chatt..."
entries.dialogueText: The courtroom came alive with chatter. Alphonso stared at me, his mouth wide open.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Hell of a second case as Chief Jus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hell of a second case as Chief Justice, isn't it? I hope the result will be similar to the first."
